mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing clobazam and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam concentrations, potentially elevating seizure control but also adverse effects.
action: Monitor for clobazam toxicity (sedation, ataxia, dizziness); consider dose reduction or alternative antibiotic if prolonged clarithromycin use; maintain seizure control monitoring.
